lines: Meeting location will be posted on each agenda
*CTCAC meetings begin upon adjournment of CDLAC meetings. Meeting dates and times are subject to change
with public notice and meeting locations may change for each meeting date. Please check agendas.
**Topics listed are not necessarily the only topics to be discussed at the meetings. Topics will be posted in the
agenda found on the CTCAC Website Meeting Page 10 days prior to the meeting date.
